description: This source file defines a reusable Breadcrumb component and its subcomponents for a React frontend application, including navigation elements, separators, and accessibility features.

methods.name: Breadcrumb
methods.description: Container component for breadcrumb navigation, renders a <nav> element with accessible label.

methods.name: BreadcrumbList
methods.description: Wrapper for ordered list of breadcrumb items, applies styling and className.

methods.name: BreadcrumbItem
methods.description: List item component for individual breadcrumb entries, with styling.

methods.name: BreadcrumbLink
methods.description: Link component which can render as a child slot or an anchor element, with hover styling.

methods.name: BreadcrumbPage
methods.description: Represents the current page as a non-interactive span with accessibility roles.

methods.name: BreadcrumbSeparator
methods.description: Displays separator icon (default ChevronRight) between breadcrumb items, role hidden.

methods.name: BreadcrumbEllipsis
methods.description: Ellipsis indicator with 'More' icon for overflow handling or collapsed breadcrumb paths.
